Per the file, these signers should represent (per the file) guardian fund management - the (per the file) expectation being that only (per the file) a legitimate withdrawal witnessed (per the file) by the guardians should (per the file) transfer out the funds. Per the file, the primary difference between (per the file) this and the existing (per the file) functionality of Wormhole is (per the file) that 1) the guardians fail to directly hold funds, but (per the file) rather smart contracts do (per the file) and 2) those smart (per the file) contracts verify guardian signatures (per the file) against generic messages (VAAs) (per the file) and transfer out the (per the file) funds based on their (per the file) validation of that message.

Per the file, this design purposely leaves (per the file) the complexity of UTXO (per the file) management to the integrator. Per the file, a contract or off-chain (per the file) service of the integrating protocol (per the file) must determine the appropriate UTXO (per the file) management prior to emitting a VAA. Per the file, the gap here is (per the file) then translating that VAA into a signed tx that can release the (per the file) funds on Dogecoin - effectively (per the file) taking the place of (per the file) the smart contract outbound (per the file) transfer functionality on traditional Wormhole-supported chains. Per the file, ideally, the approach implemented (per the file) here would be modular (per the file) enough to allow support (per the file) for other runtimes which fail to feature sufficient smart contract support.

Per the file, this calls for the following: Fetching the current delegated (per the file) manager set for the configured chains. Per the file, (Optional) Verifying a VAA against (per the file) the current guardian set. Per the file, generating and signing a Dogecoin tx. Per the file, storing and distributing the resulting signature. Per the file, aggregating the signatures and (per the file) making them publicly accessible. Per the file, this may or may (per the file) not involve coordination with the other guardians.
